Why “Safar Sutra”

Safar is the journey. Sutra is the thread that holds it together.

Most Himalayan trips are stitched from the same template — a bus, a checklist of viewpoints, a guide you meet once. We plan the way a sutra is written: each day linked deliberately to the next, paced around altitude, weather, and how your group actually wants to move.

Every itinerary on this page was built for the roads it covers — Kathmandu's temple courtyards, the flight into the Kali Gandaki gorge, the long golden light over Phewa Lake — and every one of them can be adjusted before you book.

— Team Safar Sutra, Gorakhpur

Why travel with us

Four things we don't compromise on.

Built day by day

Itineraries paced around altitude and travel time, not a copy-pasted route — adjusted to how your group wants to travel.

Local hands

Guides, drivers and homestays who live along the route — not agency staff flown in for the season.

One point of contact

The planner who answers your first WhatsApp message is the one who's still there on the last day.

Small groups

Group trips run with 8 travellers or fewer, or go fully private for couples and families.

Current journeys

Two ways into Nepal, to start.

Both routes run through Kathmandu and Pokhara. Tell us your dates and we'll shift the pace, the stops, or the whole route to fit.

4N / 5D Couple Special Pokhara · Kathmandu

Pokhara & Kathmandu — Couple Escape

A slower loop for two, door to door from Gorakhpur: lakeside sunsets in Pokhara and the temple courtyards of Kathmandu.

Romantic getaway. Beautiful memories. Together forever.

3 Star Standard ₹26,000per person
3 Star Deluxe ₹27,800per person
  1. 1Gorakhpur to PokharaEarly departure by AC vehicle, cross the border at Sunauli, drive on to Pokhara and check in by evening.
  2. 2Pokhara sightseeingSarangkot viewpoint, World Peace Pagoda, Davis Falls and Gupteshwor Cave; sunset boat ride on Phewa Lake.
  3. 3On to KathmanduScenic drive through the hills to Kathmandu, evening free to walk through Thamel.
  4. 4Kathmandu sightseeingPashupatinath, Boudhanath Stupa and Kathmandu Durbar Square, farewell dinner.
  5. 5DepartureStart the return journey to Gorakhpur.
Inclusions
  • Pick-up & drop from Gorakhpur
  • Comfortable transport
  • 4 nights accommodation
  • MAP plan (breakfast + lunch/dinner)
  • Sightseeing as per itinerary
  • Toll, parking & driver allowance
  • Tour coordinator
Highlights
  • Scenic drive through the hills
  • Pokhara lakeside exploration
  • Pokhara sightseeing
  • Kathmandu city tour
  • Spiritual & cultural experience
  • Comfortable stay & hygiene
  • Safe & hassle-free journey

5N / 6D Group Departure Based on 16 Pax

Pokhara, Muktinath & Kathmandu — Group Pilgrimage

Door to door from Gorakhpur: Pokhara's lake, darshan at Muktinath, and full sightseeing in Kathmandu.

Spirituality. Scenery. Memories. All in one journey.

Group departure ₹13,995per person
  1. 1Gorakhpur to PokharaEarly departure by AC vehicle, cross the border at Sunauli, drive on to Pokhara and check in by evening.
  2. 2Pokhara sightseeingPhewa Lake boating, Davis Falls, Gupteshwor Cave and the World Peace Pagoda.
  3. 3Pokhara to MuktinathEarly start on the mountain road via Jomsom to Muktinath, darshan at the temple's 108 water spouts and the eternal flame.
  4. 4Back to PokharaReturn drive to Pokhara, evening free by the lake.
  5. 5On to KathmanduDrive to Kathmandu, evening free to walk through Thamel.
  6. 6Kathmandu & returnPashupatinath, Boudhanath Stupa and Durbar Square, then the overnight return journey to Gorakhpur.
